lastRequest: Build a fullstack AI Resume Keyword Scanner web application with React, Express, PDF upload parsing, match score calculation, and detailed keyword breakdown.

tasks.title: Define MongoDB Schema with Prisma
tasks.description: Initialize Prisma with MongoDB connector and define User, Resume, JobDescription, and AnalysisResult models.

tasks.title: Develop Express Backend Services
tasks.description: Implement authentication via JWT, file upload middleware, PDF parsing logic, and NLP matching engine.

tasks.title: Implement REST API Endpoints
tasks.description: Create routes for authentication, resume processing, job description input, history retrieval, and report export.

tasks.title: Build React Frontend Application
tasks.description: Develop UI with Tailwind CSS, integrating react-query for state, framer-motion for animations, and recharts for analytics.

tasks.title: Integration and Validation
tasks.description: Perform end-to-end testing of user flows, including file upload to result generation, and verify JWT security.
